supporting_pages.title: "Receiving payments from Google \_|\_ Google Cloud Marketplace Partners \_\
evidence_snippets: Note: Starting April 21, 2025, Google Cloud Marketplace calculates revenue share percentage for Cloud Marketplace transactions in accordance with the Vendor Net Revenue Schedule , where applicable.
You also get a monthly usage and disbursement report that shows the usage and revenue for your products.
Google computes the revenue split and posts your share to your disbursement account.
